subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should become part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group history be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but changing session keys crosses persisted history, bot-account authorization, and upgrade boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
options.body: Include normalized Feishu account identity in group session keys and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: Platform Identity Scoped Sessions
options.body: Use appId or another proven Feishu platform identity if maintainers want durable keys to reflect upstream app semantics rather than OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer To Broader Identity Design
options.body: Keep this issue open until Feishu multi-bot mention, DM identity, and group session work converge on one shared model.

recommendation.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
recommendation.body: Include normalized Feishu account identity in group session keys and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the freshest Feishu identity/path history in current main and related PR review context.
